title: This is a hack to allow me to specify a target to an individual PPA with simpler syntax:
description:
This is a hack to allow me to specify a target to an individual PPA with simpler syntax:
    --to ppa:karljs/my_ppa

Because for whatever reason, the API wrapper can handle that syntax for teams, but not for individuals, which instead requires me to use a syntax I'm not familiar with:
    --to ~karljs/ubuntu/my_ppa
diff:
diff --git a/lputils.py b/lputils.py
index 6907fad..3c263c7 100644
--- a/lputils.py
+++ b/lputils.py
@@ -78,8 +78,15 @@ def setup_location(args, default_pocket="Release"):
     archive = None
     if getattr(args, "archive", False):
         # Try parsing an archive reference first.
+        archive_ref = args.archive
+        # Convert ppa:user/name format to ~user/ubuntu/name format
+        # which getByReference seems to require
+        if archive_ref.startswith("ppa:"):
+            parts = archive_ref[4:].split("/")
+            if len(parts) == 2:
+                archive_ref = f"~{parts[0]}/ubuntu/{parts[1]}"
         archive = args.launchpad.archives.getByReference(
-            reference=args.archive)
+            reference=archive_ref)
         if archive is None:
             raise AssertionError("No such archive: %s" % args.archive)
     else:
